Hi Oliver / Sana —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery so we have a shared starting point for the POC: 

1) Success criteria (what Finlytics will evaluate):
- Latency: 95th percentile inference < 150ms for the 512-token typical workload
- Throughput: support 10 concurrent inference streams without errors
- Cost: average per-1k-token cost below $X (we'll firm up after baseline run)
- Quality: sample prompt set accuracy / hallucination rate baseline (we'll define the exact eval prompts)

2) Scope for week 1 (Nov 2-8):
- Access & data: Finlytics provides a representative dataset (10-20 sample records) + a service account/credentials for S3 access by Tuesday EOD (Oliver)
- Environment: Redwood will provision a dedicated POC runner and share a runbook (Marcus/Dev)
- Baseline run: initial inference run on 100 prompts to collect latency/cost metrics (Dev)
- Eval plan: agree on 20 gold prompts for quality checks (Marissa + Oliver)

3) Owners & timings:
- Oliver: share sample data + service account by Tue 11/3
- Marcus/Dev: infra prep and runbook delivered by Wed 11/4
- Marissa: coordinate eval prompts + weekly status updates

Attachments: I'm attaching a short SOW and our suggested runbook template. Let me know if you want any changes.

Attachments:
- finlytics-poc-sow.pdf (1 page)
- redwood-poc-runbook.md (run steps + checklist)

Next steps: if this looks good I'll schedule a quick kickoff with your engineering lead (30 min) for Wed or Thu.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
